sample_remedies.prescription_text: Friday dana for Venus (BPHS Ch.93): donate white silk cloth, sugar, curd, silver, and white flowers to women or a Lakshmi temple on Fridays. Kumari puja — feeding and gifting young unmarried girls — is the highest Venus dana.
Chant Shukra Ashtottara Shatanamavali 108 times on Fridays. Venus governs love, beauty, relationships, and luxury.
sample_remedies.mantra_transliteration: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah

sample_remedies.prescription_text: For Vashya Dosha: recite Shukra Ashtottara on Fridays.
For Vish Kanya Dosha: perform the prescribed Vish Kanya Shanti puja before marriage.
For Yoni Dosha (enemy-yoni nakshatras): worship Kamadeva (or Parvati) on Fridays for harmonious union.
For Venus-related wealth affliction (Venus in 6H/12H, debilitated in Virgo, or Shukra dasha poverty): recite Shri Sukta (Rigveda Khilani, 16 verses) on Fridays before Lakshmi puja.
Wear a tested Diamond (Heera) in silver on the prescribed finger, on Friday, during Shukla Paksha. ONLY if Venus is a functional benefic in the chart (test for 3 days first before committing).
sample_remedies.contraindications: Gemstones strengthen the planet — wear ONLY if the planet is a functional benefic for the chart; otherwise they amplify malefic results.
